notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Service/version scan of NFS ports (111 rpcbind, 2049 NFS). Confirms NFS is running and identifies the RPC service registration. Precursor to showmount and NSE enumeration.

=== CHAINING ===
Port scan 111+2049 → confirm NFS/RPC running → showmount -e for export list → nmap nfs-ls NSE for content → mount for direct access.
